test_title: PYST 11: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 15 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the given letter-clusters will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

EUZB, ISXE, MQVH, ?, UMRN
solution:
According to the English dictionary and their positional values:
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d12502c2ca7d9724c6b72807e815218baf7d8f4c343b106b5314067691645b.png] 
The pattern followed in the given series is:

** First alphabet is increased by 4 positional values.

 Second alphabet is decreased by 2 positional values.

 Third alphabet is decreased by 2 positional values.

 Fourth alphabet is increased by 3 positional values.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d0844e4eea6f9f88c1a36ae38c21b0041420f45ad08a195a44147c8f7d46d53.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **option (2.)**
